text:
Dylan Cozens' biggest moment this season wasn't a goal. On Nov. 1 in Anaheim he was ejected for a high hit on AJ Greer, TSN reported, and Sportsnet reported Greer went on injured reserve afterward. Cozens was back in Ottawa's lineup for the next game, on Nov. 4.

Before that night, he'd been finding a groove on Tim Stützle's wing, as Coming Down the Pipe's Graeme Nichols wrote: five points in back-to-back games against Los Angeles and San Jose. He has 10 points in 18 games, plus 51 hits, and his 10.8% shooting is a little under his range.

The puzzle is defense. Evolving-Hockey had him in the 98th percentile among forwards at taking chances away last season. This season Ottawa's 5v5 expected-goal share is 46% with him and 8.5 points better without him. That's 18 games against a full season of strong two-way play, and we'd trust the bigger sample, but it's the thing to watch. He's also pointless in three straight. Our projection: 53 points.
headline: Cozens on Stützle's wing, after a hit that cost him
